summary: Enlight Renewable Energy Ltd., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K announcing its intention to release Q2 2026 financial results before the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange opens on August 4, 2026, and to host two conference calls (English and Hebrew) with CEO Adi Leviatan and management to discuss the results and business outlook. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC action, or abrupt management change is reported. The filing is a routine earnings announcement conference call notice, which does not constitute a special situation under the classification criteria.
